name: Atoa Pay for WooCommerce
author: Atoa Pay

sections.description:
Stop overpaying on every sale. Start getting paid the way your business deserves.

Atoa Pay is the smarter payment plugin for UK businesses — combining Pay by Bank, card payments, Google Pay, and Apple Pay in one beautifully simple WooCommerce integration. Fewer fees. Faster money. Zero hassle.

Pay by Bank — The Future of Checkout

Your customers open their banking app, tap to approve, and they’re done. No card numbers to type. No passwords to remember. Just a smooth, secure payment that lands in your account faster than any card ever could.

  • Save up to 50% on fees — Open Banking payments skip the card networks entirely
  • Instant or next-day settlement — your money arrives sooner, every time
  • Zero chargebacks — bank-authorised payments eliminate fraud disputes for good

All major UK banks supported. Live bank logos shown at checkout automatically.

Card, Google Pay & Apple Pay — All Included

Give every customer their preferred way to pay. Atoa handles Visa, Mastercard, Google Pay, and Apple Pay alongside Pay by Bank — under one account, one dashboard, one API key.

Up and Running in Minutes

You’ll need an Atoa account to get started. Sign up at dashboard.paywithatoa.co.uk

  1. Grab your API key from the Atoa dashboard
  2. Install and activate the plugin
  3. Paste your key, choose your store, hit save — you’re live

No developers. No complicated setup. No waiting.

Everything Your Store Needs

  • Classic & Block Checkout — works seamlessly with both
  • Multi-store ready — manage multiple locations from one account
  • Sandbox mode — test everything before going live
  • Always in sync — automatic payment status checks so no order is ever lost

Trusted. Regulated. Secure.

Atoa is an FCA-authorised UK Payment Institution (FRN #1007647), ISO-27001 and SOC2 certified.

By installing Atoa Pay, you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Full documentation is available at docs.atoa.me.
sections.installation:
Step 1 — Get your API key

  1. Log in to your Atoa dashboard.
  2. Go to Settings → API Access and generate a Production API key.
  3. Copy the key — you’ll need it in the next step.

Step 2 — Install the plugin

  1. In your WordPress admin go to Plugins → Add New Plugin.
  2. Search for Atoa Pay, click Install Now, then Activate.

Step 3 — Go live

  1. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
  2. Click Manage next to Atoa – Pay by Bank App.
  3. Paste your Access Secret, select your Store Location, and tick Enable this payment method.
  4. Click Save changes.

To also accept card, Google Pay, and Apple Pay: click Manage next to Atoa – Pay by Card, enable it, and save.

Card payments must be active on your Atoa account. Contact hello@paywithatoa.co.uk if they are not yet enabled.

Testing: Enable Sandbox Mode on the Pay by Bank settings page to test without real transactions.
sections.faq:
Do I need separate accounts for bank and card payments?

No. One Atoa account and one API key covers Pay by Bank, Pay by Card, Google Pay, and Apple Pay. Enable or disable each method independently from your WooCommerce settings.

Which UK banks are supported?

All major UK banks are supported. The full list is shown live at checkout, fetched automatically from Atoa.

Does this work with the WooCommerce block checkout?

Yes. Atoa Pay works with both the classic WooCommerce checkout and the modern block-based checkout used by Gutenberg and Full-Site Editing themes.

How do I test before going live?

Enable Sandbox Mode on the Pay by Bank settings page to test the complete payment flow — checkout, redirect, and order status updates — without processing real transactions.

What if there’s a connection issue during payment?

The plugin automatically checks payment status at 5 minutes, 30 minutes, 1 hour, 4 hours, and 24 hours after checkout. Orders are always updated correctly, even if there’s a temporary network issue.

I have multiple store locations. Can I choose which one to use?

Yes. The plugin fetches all your active store locations and presents them in a dropdown. Select the right one for your store and refresh the list anytime with one click.

What card and wallet payment methods are supported?

Visa, Mastercard, Google Pay, and Apple Pay.

What happens when a payment fails or expires?

The customer is redirected back to the checkout to try again, and the order status updates automatically.

Which countries is Atoa Pay available in?

Atoa Pay is currently available for UK-based businesses only. All payment methods — Pay by Bank, Pay by Card, Google Pay, and Apple Pay — are supported within the UK.
